notes: panda_control step5c (gen_excitation_traj.py --amp-yaw 0 --amp-roll 0), the excitation behind their v2 fit. panda_v3.json's two-band position sweep with orientation held at the anchor, so it excites the arm without the yaw/roll terms that drive J1 and J5/J7. Per-axis bands are module constants in panda_traj.py: x (0.15, 0.70), y (0.20, 0.90), z (0.30, 1.10) Hz. The stated amplitude is the LOW band's -- sin + 0.2*sin peaks at 1.2x it. Ramp-IN only, so the episode ends mid-swing.
name: step5c
track_abort_note: panda_control's step5c/step5d collector values. Orientation is held, so the rotation abort cannot bind.
